gloss: headnote; note printed at the top of a page

definitions.gloss: headnote; note printed in the top margin
definitions.explanation: An annotation placed in the top margin of a page, above the main text. Common in annotated editions of classical or scholarly works, where it comments on the passage below it.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{頭注|とうちゅう}が{詳|くわ}しい。
{古典|こてん}の{注釈書|ちゅうしゃくしょ}では、{頭注|とうちゅう}に{語句|ごく}の{説明|せつめい}が{付|つ}いている。
examples.english: In annotated editions of the classics, explanations of words and phrases appear in the headnotes.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {頭|とう} (head, top) + {注|ちゅう} (note, annotation). Literally "a note at the top (of the page)."

RELATED TERMS:
- {脚注|きゃくちゅう}: footnote — a note at the foot of the page
- {傍注|ぼうちゅう}: marginal note — a note in the side margin
- {注釈|ちゅうしゃく}: annotation, commentary — the general term
